pictures.author: A.Savin, Wikipedia
pictures.inspected: Outside front: paired slim white cylindrical gate towers, blind arched panels within shallow rectangular framing, low plinths, flared round cornices, curved green seamed bell roofs and thin green finial vanes. Central approach remains open; modern green visitor barriers/signs omitted.

pictures.author: Karel x
pictures.inspected: Inside view: actual arched green wooden doors on the estate-facing sides, white side blind arches, deeply flared green bell roofs and attached low white outer wing wall. Modern barriers and people are not copied. Hidden hardware/wing extents remain approximate.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Both entrance gate towers as one geographically anchored ensemble: slim white round masonry bodies, low plinths, projecting circular cornices, curved green bell roofs, small finial vanes, physically recessed blind arched panels and arched green wooden doors on the estate side. Two short attached low white wing walls complete the historic exterior interpretation. The central entrance and original road ground stay open. Temporary visitor barriers, signs, people and interiors are omitted; exact door/wing inventory, levels and roof seam details remain reconstructed. No photograph pixels or inscription artwork copied.
